description: One week's updates as two pull requests on Monday morning: what ends up in the APK or the web UI bundle, and the tools. Majors only after approval on the dashboard, security fixes at once.

packageRules.description: What ends up in the APK or the web UI bundle is a fix, so its update leads to a patch release; tools and tests stay chore
All minor and patch updates of tools and tests in one pull request

What ends up in the APK or the web UI bundle in one fix pull request (after the tools rule, later rules win); Kotlin compiler and libraries, AGP and desugaring stay together. A Gradle plugin matches by its package name <id>:<id>.gradle.plugin, not by its id
Every major only after approval on the dependency dashboard: it needs work of its own (Node stays on 24 and TypeScript on 5 for openapi-typescript and typescript-eslint, AGP majors change the build)
JDK stays on 17 (Gradle toolchain and Android). mise's java has the package name java-jdk, so it matches by its dep name
